model: CTS602 controller with HMI350T panel (Modbus version 23)
equipment_type: Heat pump / ventilation unit controller (air handler)
applies_to: Nilan ventilation, heat-recovery and compact heat pump units with the CTS602 board and HMI350T user panel, Modbus protocol version 23 (software 3.6.58/3.6.59).
summary: The Nilan CTS602 is the controller in Nilan's residential and light-commercial ventilation units and compact heat pumps (ventilation, heat recovery, hot water and optional central heating). Its RS-485 port COM1 is a Modbus RTU slave at fixed 19200 8E1. Input registers give temperatures T0-T18 (x0.01 °C), humidity, CO2, digital inputs, alarm list, run and control states, fan steps and differential-pressure flows; holding registers carry on/off, operation mode, ventilation step, temperature setpoint, hot water and central heating settings, outputs and the clock.

addressing.note: Nilan lists the addresses exactly as sent in the Modbus request, without the 30001/40001 global offset: reading input register 100 with function 04 is global address 30101. Use the printed number directly as the wire address.

source.title: Protocol description - Nilan CTS602 with HMI350T - Modbus version 23
source.pages: p. 5 (setup, functions), p. 6 (addressing note), pp. 6-11 (input registers), pp. 12-20 (holding registers), p. 21 (example frames)

notes: Nilan does not host this protocol description at a public URL we could find (its manuals say it can be downloaded from the Nilan website, but no direct link turned up). The linked copy, hosted by the home-automation vendor TapHome in its 'manufacturer' folder, is the unchanged Nilan document 52173104.
Scale column: '100' means the raw value is divided by 100 (e.g. temperatures and % values with two decimals). Registers without a scale are whole numbers.
Signedness is not stated per register; temperatures and temperature settings are typed INT16 because they can be negative (the list shows ranges down to -40.00 °C), everything else UINT16.

Left out: software version text registers (1-3, two ASCII characters each), suction/discharge pressure (219/220, no scale given), registers scaled by 60 (1503, 4018) whose unit is unclear, user-function temperature/offset (604/605 and their user-function-2 copies 614/615) and fan-scaling (4098/4099) which have no scale, the pressure-control P/I settings (2300-2304), the alarm log detail block (3050-3074), week-program editing registers (4030-4036) and the menu-open flag (2002).

Enumerations are only given where the list prints the full value set; several holding registers in the display section (e.g. 4003-4005, 4012, 4013, 4020, 4021, 4041, 4108-4112) are listed without their complete value lists and are left without values.

Some holding-register descriptions in the source are in Danish (2300-2327 'Trin n tilluft/fraluft' = step n supply/extract air flow or pressure, 1209 heat source select); they are translated in the names here.
The document does not mark which holding registers are read-only; the output registers 100-206 and the clock 300-305 report states rather than commands.
All input registers can also be read as holding registers with function 03 at address + 10000 (read only).

External fire alarm auto reset (holding 4040) is left without value labels: the printed table shows codes 0-2, but the cell is cut off and the document's text layer holds a further code 3 that is not visible.

integration.summary: Connect to COM1 (CN7 pins 2/3/6) at 19200 8E1, slave 30. Read input registers 200-222 for temperatures and air quality, 1000-1002 for run/mode/state and 400 for alarms; command the unit with holding registers 1001 (on/off), 1002 (mode), 1003 (ventilation step) and 1004 (temperature setpoint, x0.01 °C).
integration.enable: No enable step: the CTS602 always answers on COM1. Only the node address can be changed (holding register 50 or the panel); speed and framing are fixed.
quirks: Only function codes 03, 04 and 16 are supported; single-register write (06) is not, so write with function 16.
Packet size is limited to 255 bytes.
setup: COM1 on connector CN7: pin 2 = Data+ (A), pin 3 = Data- (B), pin 6 = ground. COM2 (pins 4/5) is the user panel bus.
Terminate both bus ends with 120 ohm; there is no opto-isolation on the CTS602, so all nodes need a common ground.
Up to 200 m of shielded twisted pair; default node address 30, selectable 1-247.
gotchas: Holding register 1007 can restore factory defaults (1) or a backup; do not write it casually.
Mode 4 (Service) in 1002 is read-only; service functions are selected through 1005.
